name: Shrouded Spirit
summary: Resistance to Necrotic and Advantage on saves against Undead magic. The price: a pound of raw flesh a day, and detection reads you as Undead.

benefit.text: The pall of death drapes over you like the Shroud of Druskenvald and turns the Undead's worst away.

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.summary: Resistance to Necrotic damage; Advantage on saves against spells and effects created by Undead.
features.text: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws against spells and effects created by Undead.

cost.text: The shroud that protects you also draws you nearer to the Undead's cold embrace.
cost.flaw: You hunger for flesh, and holy senses take you for one of the dead.

features.name: Unholy Appetite
features.summary: You must eat a pound of raw flesh (it needn't be fresh) each day or suffer Malnutrition.
features.text: You must consume one pound of raw flesh per day (it need not be fresh) or suffer Malnutrition.

features.name: Withering Soul
features.summary: Features that detect creature type, such as Divine Sense or Detect Evil and Good, treat you as Undead.
features.text: Features that detect your creature type, such as a Paladin's Divine Sense or the Detect Evil and Good spell, treat you as Undead if your creature type is not Undead already.
